name: 30 Pack - 30x1g Pre-roll - Pave
description:
Thirty joints, one box. The 30 Pack Pave gives you thirty full-gram pre-rolls — 30 grams total — rolled with quality flower and ready to smoke. No grinding, no rolling, no running out. Just grab one and go.

Pave is a standout hybrid from Compound Genetics, a minty, gassy cross of Paris OG and The Menthol. Expect a distinctive profile: cool menthol and mint up front, layered with sweet grape and stone fruit, then finished with the earthy, gassy OG backbone the strain is known for. The effect lands balanced — a bright, clear-headed lift paired with smooth full-body relaxation, making it a versatile pick that works day or night. 
Leafly

Why you'll love it:

30 × 1G pre-rolls — 30 grams total, serious value in one box
Ready to smoke — no grinding, no rolling, no setup
Signature Pave flavor — cool mint and menthol with sweet fruit and earthy gas
Balanced hybrid effects — clear-headed and relaxed, great any time of day

Big value, dependable quality, and everyday convenience in every box. The 30 Pack Pave is ready whenever you are.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
